transcript.text: Here's how to defeat Velgar in RuneScape Dragon Wars 1.0. I would recommend using
magic as long as you are up to par with your tiers for armor and staff. Bring your best consumables that you can as
far as food, drink, if you have potions as well. And then make sure if you can craft magical focus if you are going
mage. Otherwise, you can do range secondary and then melee if you're doing primary melee and you refuse to do the
other ones of course. It'll just be easier if you do mage or range. You also want to make sure you bring anti-poison
with you just because if you do get hit by the AoE poison attacks and whatnot, uh you will want that on you so you
don't lose health quickly. If you're going mage like me, make sure you don't use fire, go with any other element just
because Velgar is immune to burn. So, there's not really a reason to use fire.
And essentially, you're just going to be going through the different phases here. And you really just need to dodge roll
out of his attacks and heal up if you accidentally get hit of course and just continue to pepper him until he's done.
